independent_epub_checks.chosen_scope: EPUB/titlepage.xhtml body#titlepage L28–41; head script refs L6–9; authored drawing tree.js L10–23/L33–47 and Snake.js L39–50
independent_epub_checks.judgment: Supported within authored document/reference scope. Cover-image metadata may be consumed by reader UI independently; do not generalize NO to all reader uses.

independent_wheel_checks.entrypoint_function_AST_summary: entrypoint() calls main(sys.argv[1:]); source parsed but never imported/executed.
independent_wheel_checks.judgment: Supported. One console script and a pipx.run entry name share one callable; neither RECORD nor declarations constitute installation, invocation, or build provenance.

source_minimum_review.judgment: Conservative within the cross-domain ledger: same-work HTML/RST, package/source members, PyPI record/payload, inherited EPUB core and same 20230704 release event remain excluded. Two distinct PyPA specifications share a source commit but define different normative objects. This is not a fresh whole-task or AF-RES-098 global deduplication review.

issues.finding: The phrase 읽기 전용 재검산 is inaccurate because analyze.py rewrites audit files and ledgers. The same paragraph correctly warns about these writes and recommends a separate checkout.
issues.effect: No effect on P/U/G conclusions, source counts, or inspected bytes; may mislead a user deciding whether an already committed checkout will remain clean.
issues.recommendation: In a later permitted root amendment, replace 읽기 전용 재검산 with 패키지 미실행 정적 재검산 or simply 정적 재검산; retain separate-checkout guidance.

limitations: No fresh external HTTP retrieval, reader/browser/JavaScript execution, EPUBCheck, wheel install/import/entrypoint invocation, or historical build run search in this review.
Static no-cover judgment is scoped to author-specified chosen document and its packaged references, not to reader chrome/bookshelf presentation or arbitrary runtime environment.

JQuery was searched for the cover filename; this review did not conduct a whole-program formal proof of every possible dynamic path. Authored drawing code and concrete reference forms supply the scoped evidence.
The package declares EPUB 3.0. The cited 3.3 reading-system specification supports the distinction between reference and runtime processing, not retroactive complete 3.3 conformance.
Cross-domain source count checked within its own ledger; the root performs any whole-task and AF-RES-098 deduplication.
Original visual cover interpretation is recorded by the author; this review did not repeat visual rendering.

minimum_reversal_evidence.epub: An author-defined or dynamically resolved cover.jpg reference from the exact chosen body, or a scoped reader trace showing that resource supplied that body canvas. A bookshelf cover preview alone would not reverse the scoped NO.
minimum_reversal_evidence.wheel: A receipt tied to this wheel digest for installation, command wrapper and actual invocation/output; declarations and valid RECORD hashes alone do not change runtime 미확인.
minimum_reversal_evidence.source_count: Evidence that one of the five counted works is an inherited work or duplicate of another counted work would lower the total; preserved raw hashes and normative-document identities make this testable.
